text: Always add: - Salt formulation variants existing generics (e.g. LISINOPRIL → LISINOPRIL HCL, ENALAPRIL → ENALAPRIL MALEATE) - Fixed-dose combinations keyword drug primary component (e.g. LISINOPRIL/HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE ACEI spec) Exclude: - Combinations non-class drugs (e.g. AMLODIPINE/ATORVASTATIN CCB spec — atorvastatin statin, antihypertensive) - Topical/ophthalmic formulations used different indication (e.g. MINOXIDIL/FINASTERIDE hair loss, APRACLONIDINE HCL glaucoma) - IV infusion bags primarily indicated different condition (e.g. DILTIAZEM HCL 0.9% NACL arrhythmia, hypertension) - Compounded products diet supplement filler (e.g. BUPROPION HCL/DIET SUPP. .15) - Drugs indicated different condition shares mechanism keyword (e.g. SACUBITRIL/VALSARTAN heart failure, hypertension; METHYLNALTREXONE BROMIDE opioid-induced constipation, obesity) - Withdrawn drugs — include spec meant capture historical use (e.g. LORCASERIN HCL included antiobesity spec historical claims) Use judgment combination products span two drug classes composite spec. Assign combo exactly one sub-spec (one whose keyword clinically distinctive component) avoid cross-spec overlap. example, AMLODIPINE BESYLATE/VALSARTAN → ARB spec (valsartan), CCB spec (amlodipine).

code: lines      <- readLines("data-raw/build_specs.R") spec_starts <- which(str_detect(lines, "DrugSpec\\$new\\(") &                      !str_detect(lines, "CompositeDrugSpec\\$new\\(")) spec_names  <- str_extract(lines[spec_starts], "^(\\w+)\\s*<-") |>   str_remove("\\s*<-")  extract_generics <- function(start_line, all_lines) {   depth <- 0; block_end <- NA   for (i in start_line:min(start_line + 80, length(all_lines))) {     depth <- depth + str_count(all_lines[i], "\\(") - str_count(all_lines[i], "\\)")     if (i > start_line && depth <= 0) { block_end <- i; break }   }   if (is.na(block_end)) return(character(0))   window      <- all_lines[start_line:block_end]   block_start <- which(str_detect(window, "generic_names\\s*=\\s*c\\("))   if (length(block_start) == 0) return(character(0))   chunk <- window[block_start[1]:length(window)]   depth2 <- 0; end <- NA   for (i in seq_along(chunk)) {     depth2 <- depth2 + str_count(chunk[i], "\\(") - str_count(chunk[i], "\\)")     if (i > 1 && depth2 <= 0) { end <- i; break }   }   if (is.na(end)) return(character(0))   str_extract_all(paste(chunk[1:end], collapse = " "), '"[^"]+"')[[1]] |>     str_remove_all('"') }  specs   <- set_names(map(spec_starts, extract_generics, all_lines = lines), spec_names) specs   <- keep(specs, ~ length(.) > 0) all_vals <- imap(specs, ~ tibble(spec = .y, generic = .x)) |> list_rbind()  all_vals |>   group_by(generic) |>   filter(n() > 1) |>   arrange(generic, spec)

title: Versioning
text: Three things can differ across versions: Codes — set ICD/HCPCS codes changes (codes added, removed, reclassified). Narrative definitions — algorithm description updated without changing codes. Code membership flags — code previously condition outcome definitions may restricted one. codes identical across versions (narrative changed), spec stores applies code set versions.

title: peridefs 0.3.0
text: Collapsed hypertension, coronary heart disease (CHD), depression, diabetes specs single version (issue #4). Previously, specs multiple versions (e.g., spec_htn_v1/spec_htn_v2) shared identical codes differed narrative defs text (e.g., whether medication criterion included); remaining single version now carries complete (formerly highest-numbered) narrative. result, following exported functions package data objects removed: get_htn_v2_codes(), get_htn_v2_defs(), spec_htn_v2; get_depression_v2_codes(), get_depression_v2_defs(), spec_depression_v2; get_diabetes_v2_codes(), get_diabetes_v2_defs(), get_diabetes_v3_codes(), get_diabetes_v3_defs(), spec_diabetes_v2, spec_diabetes_v3; spec_ascvd composite longer "chd_v2" component ("chd_v1", now carrying merged definition). Use get_htn_v1_codes(), get_depression_v1_codes(), get_diabetes_v1_codes() (_defs() counterparts) going forward — now return current definition. CodeSpec$get_codes()/CompositeCodeSpec$get_codes() output (therefore get_ascvd_codes() similar composite accessors) longer duplicates version number inside class column. class now component’s unversioned condition identifier (e.g., "chd"), version continues hold version tag (e.g., "v1") separately — previously class held full versioned component key (e.g., "chd_v1"), duplicated information already present version. downstream code filtering class == "chd_v1"-style values needs filter class == "chd" version == "v1" instead.
